Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Rotterdam hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 18 Rotterdam hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Agoda at 4, Super.com at 4, aohostels.com at 1, Bluepillow.com at 1, Booking.com at 1, Hotels.com at 1, Tripening Hotels at 1 and upps at 1. These are the Rotterdam rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 14 of the 16 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at Rotterdam hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 28% ($50 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 23% at Polderhuis Bed & Breakfast to 47% at De Coaster & Het Aquarium. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
